releases.new: Set the parametrize_long_str_id_strategy option to control how long string parameter values appear in auto-generated test IDs.
releases.breaking: Positional indirect, ids or scope in parametrize now raises TypeError, and pluggy 1.6 or newer is now required; pass them as keywords.

releases.new: Add a max-warnings option that fails the test run when the number of warnings exceeds a chosen threshold.
releases.breaking: With doctest-modules, inline module, package or session autouse fixtures in test modules may now run twice; move them to conftest.py.
Blocking a conftest.py file with the -p no: option now raises a UsageError, so remove any such option from your configuration.
Terminal progress reporting from 9.0.0 is now off by default except on Windows; enable it again by passing the terminalprogress plugin option.
